lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a non-linear grid pattern posterior to the gill slits; a prominent central cluster consists of four spots forming a rough parallelogram.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots, specifically visible in the mid-lateral section where spots align with the center of the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal carina is visible on the upper flank, displaying a strong vertical gradient with high-intensity pixels on the upper edge and a distinct shadow-defined lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least five distinct, high-luminance circular spots are visible within the boundary of the first dorsal fin, distributed primarily along the middle and posterior portions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank, clustered towards the leading edge.
